name: NL8902 / NL8902AN / NL8902GR
type: JFET-input audio dual, unity-gain stable, SMD only
tagline: Nisshinbo's 2025 'entry' JFET dual built on MUSES know-how; one Japanese DIYer ranks it above MUSES8920 and NL8802.

lineage.note: Launched 2025-05-13 as JFET counterpart of bipolar NL8802. Sole source; Macnica distributes it.

lineage.vendor: New Japan Radio (JRC) / Nisshinbo MUSES line
lineage.note: Marketed as MUSES sound technology with improved productivity. Link to JRC NJM8901 or MUSES8920 die unknown.

part_numbers.note: Series name; announced 2025-05-13. Not a MUSES8920/8920A/8921 revision.
EMP-8 (EMP-8-AN). Stocked by Akizuki, Kyohritsu eleshop, Profusion. No DIP-8 version.
DFN4035-8-GR. In the launch release; full ordering code and stock not seen.

key_specs.value: ±4.0 V to ±16 V (reportedly; one summary: 4–16 V)

reputation.summary: Little coverage outside Japan. Blogger new_western_elec ranked it top in a Sept 2025 A/B (OPA2604 < MUSES8820 < MUSES8920 < NL8802 < NL8902), hearing more treble extension and detail than MUSES8920. NS-kobo's phono-EQ test reportedly preferred it to OPA2604AP. Macnica's 'on par with higher-end models' is marketing. No ASR or other independent measurements exist.
typical_uses: DAC output, line and phono-EQ stages via EMP8-to-DIP8 adapter
caveats: Praise comes from one or two Japanese hobbyist listeners; no independent measurements.
SMD only (EMP-8 / DFN4035-8). DIP sockets need an adapter, which can colour comparisons.
Only press-release typical figures are known; datasheet min/max tables and version unchecked.
new_western_elec worries about supply, citing Nisshinbo restructuring and past MUSES discontinuations (opinion).
Not a revision of MUSES8920/8920A/8921; those are separate parts.

counterfeit_notes: No NL8902 fakes reported. Cheaper non-MUSES branding may deter counterfeiters, unlike faked MUSES01 (inference). It ships only in EMP-8 and DFN4035-8, so a native DIP-8 'NL8902' is suspect; retailer DIP adapters are fine. Buy via Akizuki, Kyohritsu, Marutsu or Macnica.
